tool_input.command:
git commit -am "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add threshold support to frai eval

- Add `--threshold <metric>=<min>` option to `frai eval` command for CI gating
- Thresholds can be specified multiple times for different metrics
- Supported metrics: exact_match, toxicity, length_variance
- Threshold passes when metric score >= minimum; fails if score is null
- Exit code: 0 (all pass), 1 (any fail), 2 (malformed threshold or unknown metric)
- JSON reports gain top-level `passed` field and `thresholds` array with { metric, min, score, passed }
- Markdown reports gain "Thresholds" section showing PASS or FAIL for each
- Reports without thresholds remain unchanged (backward compatible)
- generateReport() now accepts optional `thresholds` parameter in frai-core
- Thresholds work with custom metrics passed to runEvaluations()
- Added comprehensive tests for threshold functionality
- Updated README with CLI and SDK usage examples

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
tool_input.description: Create commit with threshold feature implementation
